text: The area of a sector of a circle of radius 14 cm with central angle 90° is (use π = 22/7)
The length of the arc of a sector of radius 21 cm and central angle 60° is (use π = 22/7)
The perimeter of a sector of a circle of radius 7 cm and central angle 120° is (use π = 22/7)
The minute hand of a wall clock is 14 cm long. The area swept by it in 20 minutes is (use π = 22/7)
From a square piece of tin of side 14 cm, a quarter circle of radius 14 cm is cut out with its centre at one corner of the square. The area of the remaining piece is (use π = 22/7)
A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre. The area of the corresponding minor segment is (use π = 3.14)
A sector of a circle of radius 7 cm has area 77/3 cm². Its central angle is (use π = 22/7)
A bicycle wheel has diameter 140 cm. The number of complete revolutions it makes to cover 1.1 km is (use π = 22/7)
Two concentric circles have radii 14 cm and 7 cm. The area of the ring between them is (use π = 22/7)

Assertion (A): The perimeter of a sector of a circle of radius 7 cm and central angle 90° is 25 cm (use π = 22/7).
Reason (R): The perimeter of a sector is equal to the length of its arc.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

text: The wiper of a car sweeps through an angle of 120° and its blade-arm is 21 cm long (the whole 21 cm cleans the glass). Find the area of the glass cleaned in one sweep. (Use π = 22/7)
A sector of a circle of radius 21 cm has area 231 cm². Find (i) its central angle, (ii) the length of its arc, (iii) its perimeter. (Use π = 22/7)
A chord of a circle of radius 12 cm subtends an angle of 60° at the centre. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment. (Use π = 3.14 and √3 = 1.73)

A square plot of side 28 m has a quarter circle of radius 7 m marked at each of its four corners, each with its centre at that corner, and the four quarter circles are paved. Find the area of the part of the plot that is not paved. (Use π = 22/7)

A horse is tied with a rope at one corner of a rectangular field 20 m × 16 m, so that it can graze the field only within the quarter circle around that corner. Find how much more area it can graze if the rope is lengthened from 7 m to 14 m. (Use π = 22/7; both ropes lie inside the field)

A running track is made of a rectangle 28 m long and 14 m wide with a semicircle added outward on each of the two 14 m sides, the diameter of each semicircle being that side. Find (i) the perimeter of the whole figure, (ii) its area. (Use π = 22/7)

A chord of a circle of radius 14 cm subtends a right angle at the centre. Find (i) the length of the chord, (ii) the area of the minor segment, (iii) the area of the major segment. (Use π = 22/7 and √2 = 1.41)

A rotating sprinkler in a park waters a sector-shaped lawn. It reaches 14 m from its fixed position and turns through an angle of 90°. (Use π = 22/7)
(i) Find the area of the lawn watered. [1]
(ii) Find the perimeter of the watered region. [1]
(iii) The sprinkler is adjusted to reach 21 m and turn through 120°. Find the increase in the watered area. [2]

The tower clock of a school has a minute hand 21 cm long and an hour hand 14 cm long. (Use π = 22/7)
(i) Through what angle does the minute hand turn in 10 minutes? [1]
(ii) Find the distance moved by the tip of the minute hand in 20 minutes. [1]
(iii) Find the area swept by the minute hand between 6:10 and 6:25. OR Find the area swept by the hour hand in 3 hours. [2]

A circular pizza of diameter 28 cm is cut by its centre into 8 equal slices. (Use π = 22/7)
(i) Find the angle at the centre of each slice. [1]
(ii) Find the length of the crust (arc) of one slice. [1]
(iii) Three slices are eaten. Find the area of pizza left and the total length of crust left. [2]

A farmer has a circular field of radius 21 m. He fences off a corner using a straight fence AB, where chord AB subtends a right angle at the centre O. The small region cut off by the fence (between the chord and the arc) is used for vegetables. (Use π = 22/7)
(i) Find the area of the sector OAB. [1]
(ii) Find the area of triangle OAB. [1]
(iii) Find the area of the vegetable region, and the cost of fertiliser for it at ₹ 40 per m². [2]
